Ever since the cloud path broke, not a single letter has reached this garden.
오늘 도와준 덕분에 오래된 문을 고칠 수 있겠네!: Thanks to your help today, we can finally repair that old gate!
Let's open the entrance first. Someone might be waiting for us.
앗, 문틈에 초대장이 끼어 있었어. 꽃빛축제에 와 달래!: Oh! An invitation was stuck in the gate. It says we're invited to the Bloomlight Festival!
It must have been sent before the storm. There are flower seeds in the envelope too.
Maybe it's not too late. Let's help these flowers bloom first.
The sprouts are peeking out! They look just like the flowers on the invitation.
Now we can give anyone who visits a warm welcome.
Let's make a place where they can rest next.
잠깐만! 그 벤치, 날개 좀 쉬어 가도 될까?: Wait! Could I rest my wings on that bench for a moment?
물론이지! 나는 루미야. 혹시 이 초대장을 아니?: Of course! I'm Lumi. Do you recognize this invitation?
That's one of my letters! I'm Tori. I still have a whole bag of invitations to deliver.
그럼 우리 정원부터 불을 켜자. 길을 찾을 수 있게!: Then let's light up our garden so everyone can find their way!
등불에 비추니까 봉투에 무늬가 보여. 섬들을 잇는 길이야!: The lantern reveals a pattern on the envelope. It's a path connecting the islands!
물이 흐르는 곳을 따라가면 되는 걸까?: Do you think we should follow the water?
The sound of a fountain will help everyone find the garden, even from far away.
푸하! 물이 다시 나온다! 잠깐, 내가 서 있는 쪽으로는 말고!: Phew! The water is running again! Wait, not toward me!
아하하! 젖었네. 나는 루미야. 분수를 고쳐 주고 있었구나?: Ha ha! You're soaked. I'm Lumi. Were you repairing the fountain?
I'm Naru, the repairer. But the waterway to the next island's greenhouse is still quiet.
망원경으로 보면 어느 길이 끊겼는지 알 수 있겠어!: The telescope should show us which part of the path is broken!
I see it! A greenhouse beyond the clouds. Its flowers are drooping.
That's my workshop. The water and light stopped flowing, so the flowers fell asleep.
This invitation is for that greenhouse too. I really want to deliver it this time.
우리 정원은 준비됐어. 이제 함께 옆 섬으로 가 보자!: Our garden is ready. Let's visit the next island together!
The door is open. Welcome! This is where I grew flowers for the Bloomlight Festival.
The leaves look strong, but the buds are tightly closed.
먼저 꽃을 살필 자리를 만들자. 도구를 어디 뒀더라…: First, let's make room to check the flowers. Where did I put my tools…
벤치를 정리하니 작업대로 쓰기 딱 좋겠어!: Now that the bench is tidy, it'll make a perfect workbench!
Found it! The waterway plans. I wondered what was rustling under that flowerpot.
Are these circles places for flowers? They look like the flower on the envelope.
That's right. Move the pots off the cold floor, and they'll feel better.
Their leaves are opening now that we've moved the pots.
These flowers need warm light to bloom. Extra water alone won't help.
나는 물 주는 것밖에 안 했는데… 등불부터 준비하자!: I've only been watering them… Let's get the lanterns ready!
봐! 빛이 닿으니까 꽃잎 하나가 열렸어!: Look! A petal opened when the light touched it!
초대장 속 꽃도 이렇게 반짝였겠지?: I wonder if the flowers on the invitation sparkled like that.
Good! Let's bring water up to the little fountain. The flowers must be thirsty too.
The little fountain is working. But one of the pipes is empty.
설계도에서는 그 물관이 어디로 이어져?: Where does that pipe lead on the plans?
To the terrace! The seed pouches for that island are still in my bag too.
From the observatory, I can see the waterway stops just before the terrace.
Reconnect the path, and both the seeds and the water can arrive again.
The greenhouse flowers are blooming! I'll pack some for the festival.
이제 꽃을 기다리는 테라스로 가자. 초대장도 함께!: Let's visit the terrace waiting for these flowers. We'll bring the invitation too!
Finally here! I've been wandering for ages, trying to deliver seeds through this gate.
There are so many empty flower beds. This would be a lovely place for a small festival.
Before we hurry on, let's make somewhere to rest. Tori's wings are drooping.
Thank you. I don't have to rest alone on this bench.
The three of us met because of the bench in the first garden, remember?
Feeling better? Let's check the flower beds waiting for their seeds.
Seed delivery complete! My bag hasn't felt this light in ages.
I've planted the greenhouse flowers too. All those empty spaces are full of color now.
Let's light the waterway so no one loses their way again.
With the lanterns lit, I can see the whole path we followed.
이제 길을 잃어도 저 불빛만 찾으면 되겠다!: Now if I get lost, I'll just look for those lights!
Good. Let's check the end of the waterway through the telescope. Something might still be blocked.
저기, 멀리서 불빛이 반짝였어. 꼭 답장하는 것 같아!: Over there! A light is flashing in the distance. It almost looks like a reply!
바람 우체국이 있는 방향이야. 구름길을 다시 알아본 걸까?: That's the direction of the Wind Post Office. Has someone noticed our cloud path again?
우리도 분수를 켜서 인사하자. 이곳은 다시 열렸다고!: Let's turn on our fountain to say hello. This place is open again!
The water reached the very end! All three gardens' waterways are connected again.
꽃도, 초대장도, 친구들도 도착했어. 이제 축제를 열 수 있겠다!: The flowers, invitations, and friends have all arrived. We can finally have our festival!
아담한 축제지만 우리가 함께 만들었잖아. 정말 고마워!: It's a little festival, but we made it together. Thank you so much!
Oh? A reply from the Wind Post Office! It says there are more undelivered letters.
그 편지도 함께 찾아가자. 오늘은 먼저, 우리 정원을 마음껏 즐기고!: Let's find those letters together too. But first, let's enjoy our garden today!
초대장이 도착한 정원: The Garden Where an Invitation Arrived
Open the old gate and meet friends who lost their way along the cloud path.
Repair the workshop's light and waterways to grow flowers for the Bloomlight Festival.
Deliver the long-awaited seeds and hold a little festival connecting all three gardens.
